description: Work with your Strata documents in ChatGPT. Find documents across your accessible workspace, read and summarize their contents, and make targeted edits or create new documents. Open the embedded Strata editor to work with documents and interactive HTML previews. Export presentations as audience-ready HTML or PDF. Sign in to Strata to access your documents; actions use your authorized permissions. PDF presentation exports consume the document owner’s capture allowance.
